buttons.label: Fork
buttons.description: Fork this conversation into a new TAB — claude, codex and pi; jcode has no fork flag and is refused

buttons.label: Fork → workspace
buttons.description: Fork this conversation into a new WORKSPACE — claude, codex and pi; jcode has no fork flag and is refused

buttons.label: Resume search
buttons.description: Search every claude, codex, pi and fleet-harness transcript and resume the picked session in skip mode

buttons.label: Relaunch skip
buttons.description: Relaunch THIS session in place with permissions bypassed — claude and codex; pi and jcode have no such flag

buttons.label: Relocate
buttons.description: Move this conversation to the project it is actually about and continue it there (claude only)

buttons.label: Archive pane
buttons.description: Close the current pane and save it to the archive widget, restorable for claude, codex and pi

buttons.label: Background agent
buttons.description: Open a pane to type a prompt, then dispatch it as a detached background agent (claude --bg; claude only)

buttons.label: Remote
buttons.description: Claude only: enable Remote Control (/remote-control) to continue this session from the phone or claude.ai

buttons.label: Handoff hr
buttons.description: Swap in the new binary WITHOUT killing panes — agents and subagents keep running

buttons.label: Restart hr
buttons.description: Fully kill & relaunch this herdr instance, restoring the session

buttons.label: Full restart
buttons.description: Hard kill tmux + agents + server (reclaim all RAM), relaunch fresh & resume
